reply_text:
Hollis, I can't promise I'll remember this. I don't have a tool that saves notes or preferences. I can read files and messages, but I can't write to your notes folder or keep a memory between conversations.

Your message stays in this DM, so if you later ask me which dock you use for Marrow Agrisupply, I can look it up here. Gate 40 is the answer it will give.

If you want a lasting record that doesn't depend on me, add a line to your own notes or your team's pickup instructions.
